meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把演示主题或现成网页变成可点击跳转的分支幻灯片,自带讲者备注
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做一份能点击跳转、带讲者备注的演示,而普通幻灯片不够用
copy.tagline_en: Turn a topic or web page into a branching clickable deck with speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clickable deck with speaker notes that plain slides can't deliver

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范撰写幻灯片组:离散页、片段揭示、分支、热点导航,带演示者模式和讲者备注;产出是可导航的 deck,不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示或 pitch deck,或要求把现有页面转成 deck 时进入。没明确要求时它先问你是否要做成幻灯片;意图不明则转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这份内容做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: 它会先确认意图,再开始撰写

say.text: 给每一页加上讲者备注
say.note: 备注只在演示者模式显示

say.text: 在第二页加个热点,跳到市场测算分支
say.note: 热点指向 slideSequences 里的支线

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode and speaker notes. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck, or to convert an existing page into a deck. If not explicit it confirms first; unclear requests route to /hyperframes.
